audio-garden.title: Community garden
audio-garden.transcript: Hello everyone. This is a message for volunteers at Saturday's community garden event. The forecast says it will rain in the morning, so we are moving the seed workshop into the library. Please arrive at ten, not nine. Bring your own gloves; we will provide the tools. You do not need gardening experience. At the end, you can take a small plant home. If you cannot stay for the whole morning, even half an hour would be a big help.

audio-station.title: station
audio-station.transcript: Attention passengers travelling to Westport. The six fifteen service has been cancelled because of a fault on the train. Your tickets will be accepted on the six forty service, which will leave from platform three instead of platform one. You do not need to visit the ticket office. If you need assistance carrying luggage, please speak to a member of staff near the information desk.

audio-cycling.title: cycling
audio-cycling.transcript: When I first started cycling to work, I thought it would save me lots of time. It didn't, at least during the first week. I kept choosing busy roads and stopping to check my map. Then a colleague showed me a quieter route through the park. The journey still takes about as long as the bus, but I arrive feeling more awake. So, for me, the biggest benefit hasn't been speed.

audio-museum.title: museum
audio-museum.transcript: Before we enter the museum, please put your notebooks in your small bags. You will need them for the sketching activity upstairs. Leave your large backpacks here in the lockers because they are not allowed in the galleries. We will meet our guide at the entrance in five minutes. Keep an eye on the time. If we are late, we will have less time for the workshop. You may take photographs, but please turn off the flash.

english-library.title: Brookfield Library — temporary changes
english-library.text: Starting next Monday, Brookfield Library will have some temporary changes. The library will be closed on Tuesday for repairs. On Wednesday, it will stay open until 8 p.m. The outside return box will remain available, including on Tuesday. Saturday storytelling is cancelled this week. Online services will remain available throughout the week.

english-rain.title: A change of plans
english-rain.text: Anna had packed a picnic before she checked the forecast. Heavy rain was expected that afternoon. She sent her friend a message suggesting the café opposite the park instead, where they could sit indoors. Her friend agreed. At the café, Anna kept the picnic food packed. Later, she brought it home unopened.

english-club.title: A message from the school club
english-club.text:
Dear families,
Next week, our gardening club will harvest some vegetables and use them in a cooking session. If your child would like to take part, please return the permission slip by Friday. Tell us about any food allergies before the session so that we can plan the ingredients safely. Thank you for helping us prepare.
The club team

english-cycling-opinion.title: A local resident writes
english-cycling-opinion.text: The new cycle lanes make it easier to travel across our neighbourhood by bike. They are a useful first step. However, some dangerous junctions still need improvement. I support the new lanes, but the council should also make those crossings safer. A good beginning can still leave work to do.

comic-agua.title: Un consejo en el jardín — cómic original
comic-agua.alt: Tres viñetas. En la primera, una persona junto a una llave de agua dice «¡Ahorremos agua!». En la segunda, la persona se aleja mientras caen gotas de la llave, junto al texto «ploc, ploc». En la tercera, una planta con ojos y boca pregunta «¿Y la llave?». La llave continúa goteando.

comic-pantallas.title: Una tarde en familia — cómic original
comic-pantallas.alt: Tres viñetas con tres personas sentadas a una mesa. En la primera, una dice «¡Una tarde para conversar!». En la segunda, una cartela indica «Media hora después» y las tres miran sus teléfonos; un globo contiene puntos suspensivos. En la tercera, siguen mirando los teléfonos y una persona dice «¡Qué conectados estamos!».
